notes.title: New Demo Trailer
notes.content:
Get Ready for Action: Mechstorm Gameplay Trailer Drops Today!
Attention, Resistance Fighters!

The Beta demo is ready reach out to us on our Instagram account to get keys:Superframe on Instagram

We are thrilled to announce the release of the official gameplay trailer for Mechstorm! This trailer showcases high-octane footage pulled from the demo, giving you an exclusive look at the vehicle combat and strategic gameplay that awaits.

Dive into the chaos of a post-apocalyptic world where humanity's survival hangs in the balance. Witness the power of customized combat vehicles, each equipped with a deadly arsenal designed to obliterate the relentless AI robot army.

Devastating combos and strategic maneuvers turn the tide of battle in your favor. The swift AI robots, armed with laser cannons, rockets, and pulse rifles, will test your skills and adaptability.

Mechstorm will feature high-speed chases, coordinated attacks, and explosive confrontations, all set to a high-energy electronic soundtrack that propels you through each level. The stunning visuals, pulse-pounding sound effects, and intuitive controls ensure an immersive and chaotic battlefield experience.

Rally your fellow resistance fighters, prepare for battle, and see what Mechstorm has in store. The future of the human race is in your hands—answer the call and become the hero that humanity deserves.

— The Mechstorm Team

notes.title: Weapons update
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the latest update to our game, with features to enhance your experience. Players can now enjoy:

Free Weapons: One of the most asked-for features for Mechstorm was the ability to fire weapons whether they are targeted or not. Weapons can now fire freely based on the camera's direction.

Advanced Targeting System: We have added a context-sensitive targeting reticle to support free-fire weapons. When there is an auto-target object, the reticule focuses there. Otherwise, it indicates the point in the world where the weapon will do damage.

Controller Support for Puzzles: The puzzle now has controller support. The beginning of the game still needs keyboard support.

Next steps: The next steps for the Mechstorm team will be weapon damage to the world, a new demo level layout, health powerups, and new narrative videos.

Dive into the game now and experience these exciting enhancements!

notes.title: Vapor Run is Now Mech Storm
notes.content:
More Co-Op Combat

We're thrilled to bring you exciting news about the evolution of our co-op vehicle combat game. After gathering valuable feedback, we're making some changes to the focus of our game. Vapor Run is undergoing a transformation and emerging as the fierce co-op robot fighting gam "Mech Storm"!

In Mech Storm, the world has plunged into chaos, with humans being driven underground by an unstoppable robotic army and a malevolent AI hell-bent on eradicating our kind. As humanity's last hope, you and a fellow player will work together, locked in an epic battle for survival against overwhelming odds. Embrace the adrenaline-pumping experience of cooperative robot warfare as you strategize, upgrade, and triumph over the forces that seek to make us extinct.

Key Features:



Co-op Robot Fighting: Engage in thrilling cooperative battles with a friend or team up with players from around the world. Together, you'll forge an unbreakable bond to combat the robotic menace, sharing resources, tactics, and victory.

Devastating Vehicles: Command an arsenal of formidable vehicles, each with unique abilities and customizable features. Discover your preferred playstyle and equip your mechanized warriors with powerful weapons, armor, and specialized gear to dominate the battlefield.

Epic Campaign: Immerse yourself in an immersive storyline as you delve into the depths of a post-apocalyptic world. Unravel the mysteries surrounding the evil AI, uncover its sinister plans, and unite humanity in a grand quest to restore peace and reclaim our future.

Challenging Missions: Face off against relentless hordes of robotic enemies in a variety of meticulously crafted missions. From pulse-pounding assaults to tactical defenses, each encounter will test your skills, teamwork, and resilience to the fullest.

Innovative Progression: Earn experience, unlock new abilities, and enhance your mechs to become an unstoppable force. Discover rare schematics, upgrade modules, and advanced technologies to gain a competitive edge and push back the forces of darkness.

Continuous Updates: Brace yourselves for a relentless stream of fresh content, including new mechs, missions, events, and gameplay features. The battle against the robot army never ends, and we'll be right there with you, ensuring an ever-evolving experience.


Prepare yourselves, Mech Storm warriors, for a battle that will reshape the future of human survival. play alone or with a friend, gear up combat vehicles, and join the resistance against the encroaching forces of darkness. It's time to rise from the ashes, unite in common purpose, and show the world that humanity's spirit cannot be extinguished!

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to embark on an unforgettable co-op robot fighting adventure when Mech Storm arrives. Together, we will prevail!

The Mech Storm Development Team

notes.title: Vapor Run Closed Beta
notes.content:
Vapor Run

Closed Beta Announcement


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43167373/46a670b30d839fbe6df8facb6e82a256d139fbf2.jpg

We are pleased to announce a closed beta for our co-op combat racing sim Vapor Run. There is more information about this game on our store page here.

If you are interested in racing through a cyberpunk wasteland with a friend, delivering packages for corporations, crime lords, and whoever can afford to hire you, definitely sign up for our newsletter and reach out on our website: https://superframe.media

To participate, you will need a modern gaming laptop (Mac//PC/Steamdeck) and a pair of headphones with a mic.

The purpose of this beta is to gather feedback about the game. For your first race, you will be racing with one of our dev team. After that, we will provide a list of other beta testers that you will be free to race with.
